_about: What brief.py reads. 'queries' become Google News RSS searches; 'feeds' are read as-is. Every item must match 'topic' and must not match 'exclude'. Buckets are checked in order on the title, then on the summary; an item lands in the first that matches, else the last bucket.
queries: "agentic commerce" fraud OR chargeback OR dispute

buckets.name: Fraud and disputes
buckets.why: What the shopper's issuing bank and the merchant are losing money on, and who is blamed.
buckets.pattern: fraud|chargeback|dispute|scam|liabilit|who pays|unauthori[sz]ed|bot traffic|bad bot|account takeover|refund abuse|financial crime|money laundering|\bAML\b|\bKYA\b|know your agent|authenticat|\brisk

buckets.name: Competitor moves
buckets.why: Mastercard, Amex and the wallets and processors that sit between Visa and the agent.

buckets.name: New agent partners and merchants
buckets.why: Who is shipping agents that buy, and which merchants let them in.

buckets.name: Rules and standards
buckets.why: Network rules, EMVCo, protocols and regulators that set who owns what.

exclude: AWS Marketplace|now available for AI agents through
